subject.title: WhatsApp replies silently dropped — routeReplyRuntime never loaded when originatingChannel === currentSurface

question: Should WhatsApp same-surface auto-replies be fixed in the plugin-owned durable dispatcher, by allowing route-reply runtime loading when the route channel equals the current surface, or by folding the behavior into the broader origin-channel policy in #54531?
rationale: Source inspection confirms the same-surface guard, but WhatsApp now has a separate plugin-local final-delivery path, so changing shared routing without maintainer intent and live proof could duplicate or misroute messages.

options.title: Live-prove then fix narrow layer
options.body: Run a current-main WhatsApp group auto-reply proof and fix the observed failing layer with regression coverage for same-surface external delivery.

options.title: Fold into #54531
options.body: Keep this as concrete WhatsApp evidence under the broader origin-channel design and resolve both through one routing policy decision.

options.title: Patch route-reply guard now
options.body: Load route-reply runtime for same-surface external channels with tests, accepting the risk that the shared path may conflict with plugin-local delivery.

recommendation.title: Live-prove then fix narrow layer
recommendation.body: Run a current-main WhatsApp group auto-reply proof and fix the observed failing layer with regression coverage for same-surface external delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: Marcus has the strongest recent merged history across the shared dispatch result and WhatsApp inbound delivery paths that need live proof and fix-layer selection.
